config.days: every scan day in the archive
config.selection: current canon on IBKR 15:30/15:45 snapshots: model credit >= 0.45x width, quoted mid >= model, pooled top-6 by GROUND at k=24; 15:30 scan, 15:45 tops up to 6
config.scoring: G = Kelly log-growth on P_real at the smile-fit model credit; GROUND = (e^G−1)·e^(−k·D_ent), k = 24
config.fill_basis: 1.00× smile-fit model credit; partial-WIN at 50% intrinsic; no commission
config.regime: bull puts every day; bear calls only below the prior-session SPY 100d SMA
config.parity: no bull parity veto; no bear parity veto
config.bear_gates: bear calls: IV < 0.35, same credit floor, share the pooled top-6. Earnings and ex-dividend gates apply to both sleeves.
config.window: 252 full sessions of realized DTE-matched moves vs the exact strikes (P_real, every trading day), drift-free: each name's window-mean return removed before counting
config.dkl: D_ent = D(Q_bs‖U₃) = ln3 − H(Q_bs), Q_bs = N(d2) at the smile-fit IVs (Mercurio–Wu–Xie 2020 eq. 19)
config.gap: P_real drift = 1 × β_year σ × z(the stock's OWN opening gap, ATR units) × √DTE; no market average
